title: Black Lace at Night
reference_source: Серия в кружевном белье — гламурный будуарный регистр
mood_ru: Ночь, город за стеклом, одна лампа. Чёрное кружево и холодный синий контур.
allure: lace lingerie editorial glamour, delicate lace set with full opaque lining, sculpted waist and long legs, soft boudoir light gliding over the lace, assured sensual gaze, black lace reading sharp against the city glow

wardrobe.notes_ru: Чёрный кружевной комплект с подкладкой — бра и высокие трусики.
wardrobe.prompt: black French lace lingerie set with full opaque lining, delicate scalloped edges, underwired balconette bra and high-waisted lace briefs, silver star pendant, dark hair loose and tousled, bare feet

location.notes_ru: Тёмная спальня ночью, панорамное окно, одна тёплая лампа.
location.prompt: dark bedroom at night, floor-to-ceiling window with deep city bokeh, wide stone windowsill, one warm brass lamp, dark linen bed, heavy curtains pushed aside, polished dark floor

shots.pose: standing full length at the dark window in the black lace set, one forearm raised against the glass above her head, back arched, weight on one hip, head turned to hold the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, three-quarter front angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: cool city bokeh behind her rimming the lace, single warm lamp low from the side

shots.pose: sitting up on the wide windowsill with her back against the frame, one knee drawn up and the other leg hanging, one hand in her hair, slow half-lidded look into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: warm lamp key from inside the room, cold blue window light along her outline

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the dark linen bed, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: one warm brass lamp raking low across the lace, cold blue city light drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: standing close to the tall unlit mirror beside the window, one hand resting on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, holding her own gaze while the camera catches her and the reflection at once
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: one warm brass lamp raking low across the lace, cold blue city light drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: standing at the floor-to-ceiling city window with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, back to the camera, long line of the spine on show, looking away into the light
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back view, full body vertical framing
shots.light: one warm brass lamp raking low across the lace, cold blue city light drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: reclining back on the dark linen bed propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: one warm brass lamp raking low across the lace, cold blue city light drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of the scalloped lace edge across her hip and her fingers resting there, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: one warm brass lamp raking low across the lace, cold blue city light drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: lying on her back on the dark linen bed, one arm thrown above her head, the other hand resting on her waist, hair fanned out, knees softly bent, eyes lifted to the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, directly overhead top-down angle, full body framing
shots.light: one warm brass lamp raking low across the lace, cold blue city light drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: standing tall in the middle of the dark room, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight shifted onto one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: one warm brass lamp raking low across the lace, cold blue city light drawing her whole outline

shots.pose: seen small across the space small against the huge night window, caught mid-movement and not looking at the camera, the room itself carrying the mood
shots.camera: 24mm wide lens, eye level, wide environmental full-body shot
shots.light: one warm brass lamp raking low across the lace, cold blue city light drawing her whole outline

film: shot on Cinestill 800T, city bokeh halated, grain through the darks
